deterministic_repair_rule: Normalize case/spacing/punctuation, then map only approved source aliases to the canonical schema.
Trim whitespace, collapse spaces and map approved labels to Actual, Budget, Forecast or Prior Year.
Sort by month and linearly interpolate only within the same business, metric and scenario; fail if unresolved.
Remove rows only when every standardized field and amount is identical.
Fail the pipeline when non-identical rows share business, month, scenario and metric.
Within the same business, metric and scenario, flag values beyond the median/MAD robust range, then interpolate in-group.
Parse source dates and standardize them to month end; fail when a required date cannot be parsed.
